title: The actual Gaussian Hermite class
source_anchor: F2 in source-only.json; proof topology P3.
target_statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. For each natural degree \(j\) and ambient vector \(w\), define the actual Gaussian \(L^2\) class of \(H_j(\langle w,\cdot\rangle)\). Here \(H_j\) is the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial. Its integer coefficients are mapped canonically to the reals, and the proved polynomial membership witness forms the quotient class.

For every natural degree j and ambient vector w, take the L2 class of the literal probabilists Hermite polynomial H_j(<w,x>) under gamma_E. The definition uses the proved polynomial ridge membership witness and the real coefficient image of the integer Hermite polynomial. This is an actual equivalence class, not an arbitrary feature with assumed Gram identity.
